critique.evidence: The headline, signed-intent/paid-cart mismatch, and side-by-side ALLOW versus BLOCK verdict communicate the core claim without a presenter. However, the next action is ambiguous: “Select any cached transaction” is instructional, but rows lack an obvious selection affordance, the play icon is unexplained, and “INSPECT THE CAUSAL SEAM” reads more like a label than a control. On mobile, very small type and the long stacked replay bury the decisive comparison and evidence below substantial scrolling; the truncated header also weakens location awareness.
critique.fix: Make the primary action unmistakable: style each row as selectable with hover/focus/selected states and add a clear “Inspect selected transaction” button. Explain or remove the play icon. On mobile, surface the selected transaction’s ALLOW/BLOCK comparison immediately after the intro, collapse the remaining replay rows, and increase supporting-text size and contrast.
